# TemporalGraphNeuralNetworks

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Graph neural network architectures that explicitly model time-varying node and edge features to capture dynamic relational structures. Bridges temporal dynamics and graph topology, critical for modeling biological neural circuits and for TCC's dynamic network-centric computing.
